tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use this to discover the canonical category paths currently represented in KaliCart Global before calling global_search with leaf. An optional parent returns that node and its full subtree. This lists category vocabulary and counts; it does not return products.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this to discover the canonical category paths currently represented in KaliCart Global before calling global_search with leaf. An optional parent returns th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_merchants · Public sink: verify_basket · Destructive: global_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_merchants · Public sink: verify_basket · Destructive: global_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "global_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
